svg.title: Beckenburg College emergency electrical plan
svg.desc: Three measured plans show the native campus basement, ground and upper level, the emergency generator and distribution board, service raceways, the twelve room switches and mounted luminaires.
svg.text: Native campus / Surveyed X–Z coordinates in metres
Courtyard generator → buried duct → west tunnel → maintenance board
The maintenance board controls the connected loads. The van is on its own battery.
